### Fixed
- **The sign-in pages no longer send portal users back to an IDE.** The OAuth proxy's pages ended with "Please return to your IDE and try again" and "Retry the previous command to continue", but the Backstage portal starts the same flow in a browser tab. They now say to close the window and go back to where the sign-in started. A sign-in link opened after its state expired (10 minutes) or was already used said "Authentication session expired. Please try again", and opening the same link again kept failing. It now says the link has expired and that a new sign-in is needed. ([#1127](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1127))
